title: Income Tax Act 2023 Section 322 – Tax VAT Point
main_content: Section 322 - Punishment for Disclosure of Protected Information Any public servant, or any person assisting, or person employed or any person connected with the implementation of this Act, discloses any protected document, special report or information in violation of the provisions of section 309 shall be punished with imprisonment for a term not exceeding 6 (six) months, or shall be punished with fine, or both. In the event of a conflict between the information on this website and the original Government publications or notifications of laws, rules, regulations, and SROs, the Government publications or notifications shall prevail.
